313: For the spirit of the creatures was in the wheels (Ezekiel 1:20); they went wherever the spirit impelled them to go (Ezekiel 1:12): Water and fire operate in [the spirit], for the spirit grasps both of them. So it pulses in the veins of the brain, as it is water; and in the veins of the heart, as it is fire; and air is in the wings of the lungs.
